nadi_dosha.description: Nadi dosha occurs when both partners share the same Nadi (Vata/Pitta/Kapha).
nadi_dosha.text: Nadi dosha is the most significant dosha in Ashtakoot matching. Occurs on same Nadi. Cancellations exist.

bhakoot_dosha.description: Bhakoot dosha arises from inauspicious rashi relationships: 6/8, 9/5, or 12/2.

cancellations.condition: Lords of both rashis are friends

bhakoot_dosha.text: Bhakoot dosha arises when the Moon signs of the two partners form a 6/8, 9/5, or 12/2 relationship. Cancelled if lords are friends.
